entries.desc: A candidate with recommend_activate, sufficient decisive helped samples, valid exposure, structured verdict source, clean lineage, and matching digest is reported eligible for activation.

evidence.note: Smoke proves a candidate with applied recommend_activate, decisive helped samples, concrete exposure, structured reviewer verdict, clean lineage, and current digest is eligible and activated.

entries.desc: Neutral/unknown outcomes and DONE settlement rows are excluded from decisive promotion denominators and cannot make a candidate eligible.

evidence.note: Smoke keeps DONE settlement/neutral rows out of helped evidence and decisive activation denominators.

entries.desc: A stale digest, duplicate lineage source, missing exposure, missing reviewed policy, or harmful outcome blocks activation with a precise reason.

evidence.note: Smoke proves missing real outcome evidence fails closed and duplicate/missing lineage blockers from the seed loop remain enforced.

entries.desc: With reviewed policy, matching digest, clean lineage, and qualifying outcome evidence, --apply activates the candidate and records an audit row without requiring an always-off environment flag.

evidence.note: Smoke proves --apply activates an evidence-qualified candidate and writes one non-authoritative activation audit row without PLAYBOOK_AUTO_ACTIVE_ENABLED.

entries.desc: Re-running --apply is idempotent and does not duplicate activation or audit rows.

evidence.note: Smoke reruns --apply after activation and proves activatedCount is 0 with exactly one activation audit row.

entries.desc: Without reviewed policy, clean lineage, qualifying outcomes, or current digest, --apply fails closed and writes nothing.

evidence.note: Smoke proves no-evidence apply fails closed and leaves playbooks non-active; activation audit binds applied decision id/idempotency/digest.

entries.desc: A later harmful or dismissed evidence profile produces a demotion/rollback recommendation for an auto-activated advisory playbook.

evidence.note: Smoke records a later active-advisory harmful outcome and proves playbook_auto_promotion_apply dry-run surfaces recommend_demote for the auto-activated playbook.

entries.desc: Manual active playbooks and auto-activated playbooks retain distinct audit provenance.

evidence.note: Smoke reads the activation audit row and distinguishes autoActivated=true in the demotion recommendation; manual activation remains separate via playbook_activate.

entries.desc: Rollback/demotion cannot erase original candidate, activation, or outcome evidence.

evidence.note: Activation uses append-only playbook-auto-activations.jsonl and leaves candidate, promotion decision, and outcome rows intact; demotion is recommendation output, not destructive deletion.

entries.desc: End-to-end fixture proves evidence-qualified candidate becomes active under reviewed activation policy and qualifying evidence.

evidence.note: Dedicated B-7ee1 smoke executes the full local path from seed/proposal/candidate through outcomes, promotion sweep recommend_activate, auto apply activation, runtime consumption, and demotion recommendation.

entries.desc: A large batch with mixed eligible/ineligible candidates activates only the eligible subset and reports skipped reasons.

evidence.note: Seed-promotion loop smoke keeps mixed eligible/ineligible surfaces: blocked seeds/proposals remain blocked while only the qualified candidate activates.

entries.desc: Story DONE, stale recommendation, duplicate source lineage, missing policy, or missing exposure cannot activate a candidate.

evidence.note: Negative controls prove DONE-style settlement, missing evidence, duplicate lineage/proposal blockers, and old default-off flag regressions cannot produce activation.
